title: Enterobius Vermicularis Infestation of the Appendix
brief_summary: This study identifies the incidence of appendiceal Enterobius vermicularis (E.v) infestation in all the patients undergoing appendectomy and evaluates the relationship between E.v infestation of the appendix and the acute appendicitis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

All routine examined appendectomy specimens

Exclusion Criteria:

Cases with clinical suspicion of tumor Cases attached to the colectomy specimens
study_population: Saudi and non- Saudi patients suffering from acute appendicitis symptoms
